paite: Huchi in Jerusalem khua atun ding kuan ua, Bethphage khua, Olive tang atun un Jesu'n nungzuite nih asawl a, akiang uah,
heading: Jesu Vualzou A Jerusalem Lutna / (Mar 11.1-11; Luk 19.28-40; Joh 12.12-19)
english: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

paite: "Na mazawn ua khua ah va hoh unla, sabiltung khih, akiang a anou toh na mu ding ua; phel unla, ka kiang ah hon kai un.
english: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.

paite: Huan kuapeuh in na kiang ua banghiam agen uleh, 'Toupa'n adeih a ahi,' na chi ding uh; ama'n ahon sawl pah mai ding," achi hi.
english: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

paite: Hiai tengteng zawlnei kam a gen ahong tuntheihna ding in ahong omta hi.
english: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

paite: "En dih, na Kumpipa, thunuailuttak in, sabiltung tung ah, sabiltungnou tung ngei a tuang in na kiang ah ahong pai, chi in Zion tanu hilh in," achih.
english: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”

paite: Huchi in nungzuite ava pai ua, Jesu'n akiang ua thu apiak bang ngei in ahihta uhi.
english: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

paite: Sabiltung leh anou ahon kai ua, atung uah apuante uh aphah ua, huai ah atuangta hi.
english: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

paite: Huan mipi lak a tamzaw in lampi ah apuante uh ana phah ua, midang in singsawl sat in, lampi ah aphah uhi.
english: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

paite: Mipi amalam a paite leh amah zuite'n, "David Tapa kiang ah Hosanna! Toupa min a hong pai ahampha hi; tungnungpen ah Hosanna!" chi in akikou uhi.
english: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

paite: Jerusalem khua ahong lut in akhua in, "Hiai mi kua ahia?" chi in aling souhsouh uhi.
english: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

paite: Mipite'n hiai mi zawlnei Jesu, Galili gam a Nazaret a ahi, achi uhi.
english: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

paite: Pathian tempul ah Jesu ava lut a, tempul a zuak mite leh lei mite tengteng adelhkhia a, dangka khengte' dohkante leh vakhu zuakte tutphahte leng asawnpaihsak hi.
heading: Jesu'n Tempul Ahihsianthouna / (Mar 11.15-19; Luk 19.45-48; Joh 2.13-22)
english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

paite: Akiang uah, "Ka inn thumna inn achi ding uh, chi a gelh ahi. Himahleh nou bel suamhatte khuk in na bawl zaw uh," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

paite: Huan tempul ah mittawte leh khebaite akiang ah ahong ua; amau ana hihdam hi.
english: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

paite: Himahleh siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n athillamdang hihte leh tempul a, David Tapa Hosanna; chi a naupang kikoute amuh un, alungkim kei mahmah uhi.
english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

paite: Akiang ah, hiaite thugen na za hia? achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Za e, 'naungekte leh nawi ne laite kam a pawt in pahtawina na hihkimta,' chih na sim ngei kei ua hia?" achi hi.
english: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”

paite: Huan amaute apaisan a, khopi a pan pawt in, Bethani ah apai a; huai ah agiakta hi.
english: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

paite: Azing a khopi lam a akik nawn lai in agil hong kialta hi.
heading: Jesu'n Theipi Kung Ahamsiatna / (Mar 11.12-14; 11.20-24)
english: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

paite: Lampi sik ah theipi kung amu a, ava naihleh anah kia lou ngal muh ding a-om kei hi. Huan akiang ah, "Tangtawn in na gah nawn ke'n," achi hi.
english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

paite: Huchi in theipi avuai pah hi. Nungzuite'n huai amuh un, "Bangchidan ahia theipi avuai pah tel?" chi in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ginna na neih ua, na ginlah kei uleh, theipi tung a hih bang phet leng na hih kei ding ua, hiai tang kiang ah na kisuan inla tuipi ah na kipailut in, chi le uchin, na chih bang un a-om mai ding hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

paite: Bangpeuh gingta a thum a na nget uh na mu ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

paite: Huan tempul alut nung a thu ahilh lai in, akiang ah siampu liante leh vantang upate ahong ua, akiang ah, "Kua thu in ahia hiai thil na hih? Kua'n thu hon pia ahia?" achi uhi.
heading: Jesu Thuneihna Ginlelhna / (Mar 11.27-33; Luk 20.1-8)
english: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng thu kam khat ka hon dong sam ding a, huai na hon hilh uleh, kua thu in hiam hiai thilte ka hih chih ka hon hilh sam ding hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

paite: Johan baptisma koi a kipan ahia? Van a kipan hia, ahihkeileh mihing a kipan?" chi in adong hi. Amau akingaihtuah ua, "Van a kipan chi lehang, bangziak a amah ginglou na hi ua le?" ahon chi dia;
english: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

paite: "Mihing a kipan chi lehang, mipi i kihta ngal ua; mi tengteng in lah Johan zawlnei in apom ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu adawng ua, "Thei kei ung," achi uhi. Ama'n leng akiang uah, "Ke'n leng kua thu in ahia hiai thilte ka hih ka hon hilh sam kei ding," achi hi.
english: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

paite: "Himahleh nou bangchi na sa ua? Mi kuahiam in tapa nih anei a, akhatna pen kiang ah ava hoh a, 'Tapa aw, kuan inla ka grephuan ah va sem ve,' achi hi.
heading: Tapa Nih Gentehna
english: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

paite: Ama'n, 'Ka ut kei,' chi in adawng hi. Himahleh aden chiang in alungsim kheng in, akuanta hi.
english: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

paite: Huan anihna pa kiang ah leng ava hoh a, tua bangmah in ava chi hi. Ama'n 'Pu, ka kuan ding, " chi in adawng a, himahleh akuanta kei hi.
english: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

paite: "Huai mi nihte akua zaw in apa uh deihlam ahih a le?" achi hi. Amaute'n, "Amasapen in," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, siahkhonte leh kizuakte'n Pathian lalgam ah nou hon lutsan ding uh.
english: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

paite: Diktatna tawn in na kiang uah Johan ahong a, amah na gingta kei uh; siahkhonte leh kizuakte'n amah agingta ua; noute'n huai na muh nung un leng amah na gintakna ding un na kisik nuam tuan kei uh.
english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

paite: "Gentehna thudang ngaikhia un; mi kuahiam inn neitu a-om a, huai mi'n grephuan abawl a, dai in a-umsuak a, grep sukna khuk atou a, inn sang alam a; loukemte kiang ah khohloh ding a pia in gamdang ah apaita hi.
heading: Grephuan Loukemte Gentehna / (Mar 12.1-12; Luk 20.9-19)
english: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

paite: Huan agah loh hun in agah lakhawm ding in loukemte kiang ah asikhate asawl hi.
english: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

paite: Loukemte'n tua sikhate ana man ua, khat avua ua, khat pen that in, adang khat suang in adeng uhi.
english: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

paite: Huai zoh in sikha dang amasa pawl sang a tamzaw asawl nawn hi. Amau tung ah leng ama ua mite ahih bangmah un ana hih nawn uhi.
english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

paite: Huai nung in, 'Ka tapa azahtak kha ding uh,' chi in atapa akiang uah asawl hi.
english: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

paite: Himahleh loukemte'n atapa ana muhtak un, hiai mipa gouluah dingpa ahi; that ni in agouluah ding tansak ni, akichi uhi.
english: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

paite: Huchi in amah aman ua, grephuan a kipan paikhia in athat uhi.
english: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

paite: Huchi in grephuan neipa ahong pai chiang in huai loukemte tung ah bangchi in ahihta dia le?" achi hi.
english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

paite: Amaute'n akiang ah, “Huai migiloute haksatak in ahihmangthang ding a, grephuan loukem midang aloh hun teng a agahte akiang a pe zel dingte kiang ah khohloh ding in ape ding," achi uhi.
english: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Inn lam mite suang deih louhpen huai ngeingei aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita. Huai Toupa hih ahi, i mitmuh in alamdang ahi, chih Laisiangthoute na sim ngei kei ua hia?”
english: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

paite: "Huaiziak in Pathian lalgam na kiang ua kipan laksak ahi dia, namdang kiang ah agahsuah ding piak ahi ding, chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

paite: Huai suang tung a puk tuh akitamgawp dia; adelhkhak mi agawizan ding," achi hi.
english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

paite: Huan siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n agentehna thute azak un amau tungthu gen ahi chih atheita uhi.
english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

paite: Huchi in amah mat atum ua; himahleh mipi'n zawlnei a apom ziak un akihta uhi.
english: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.
